title: Evaluation of training offers within the framework of the Center for Competence Development in Cancer Self-Help (ZfK KSH)
summary: As part of the Center for Competence Development in Cancer Self-Help, funded by German Cancer Aid, training courses are designed and offered for various target groups in cancer self-help. The face-to-face and online events, which are thematically based on a needs analysis in the member associations of the HKSH, are assessed and scientifically evaluated by participants and lecturers. The evaluation criteria for participants are the comprehensibility of the content, the increase in knowledge experienced, the importance of the content for dealing with their own illness and self-help activities, and the performance of the lecturer. The lecturers give their feedback on the interest of the participants, the atmosphere and the actual implementation of the planned methods. In the survey four months after the training event, the participants are questioned again and assess the transfer of the newly acquired knowledge in relation to their activities in self-help and in dealing with their illness. In addition to the face-to-face events, individual topics are prepared as e-learning courses with the same evaluation concept and the addition of items to assess user-friendliness and manageability.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of breast (C50), Malignant neoplasm fo bronchus and lung (C34)
Multiple myeloma and malignant plasma cell neoplasms
Malignant neoplasm of other and ill-defined sites in the lip, oral cavity and pharynx

interventions.name: Collection of evaluation data by written questionnaires from participants and lecturers directly after the training (T1) as well as four months later from participants (T2)
